summary: Reconciling a candidate issue to a routed decision is one command that hydrates the issue once, applies the whole decision, and appends its audit trail from the body it already holds, never from a second read.
reason: Routing a candidate is several mutations (state, labels, parent, description note) that must agree about which issue body they saw. Splitting them across commands, or re-reading between them, reintroduces the lost-update the append guard exists to prevent and can leave an issue half-routed with an audit note that describes a state it never reached.
validated_outcome: A reconcile run against a live workspace moves the issue, records the decision in its description, and reports the before and after body it acted on, with no read between hydration and the write.
